Role: Staff Product Manager, AI Applications
Location: Remote, USA
Level: Staff

Requirements:
- Excellent product management judgment; owning product and roadmap
- A shipped product that people paid for (consumer or prosumer)
- Zero-to-one product definition (idea to first version real users adopted)
- Deep AI fluency proven by shipped work (personally building/shipping AI into end-user apps)
- Technical depth (models, latency, privacy, platform trade-offs; reads code; prototypes)
- Design sense (simple interfaces, mockups, prototypes, user testing)
- Distrusts a metric before building on it
- Clear communication with executives

Preferred:
- Native desktop or mobile app building (Windows, macOS, iOS)
- Shipping through distribution partners
- Voice, audio, or real-time systems
- Company with both self-serve and enterprise motions

Responsibilities:
- AI application product line strategy
- Acquisition, activation, retention, monetization metrics
- Prototyping
- Research and engineering partnership
